dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, Ploy is coming to our party on Saturday!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈplɔɪ ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ tə aʊər ˈpɑːrti ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I love her personality. She's a person who always has great ideas.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪ ˈlʌv hɜːr ˌpɜːrsəˈnæləti. ʃiːz ə ˈpɜːrsən huː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhæz ˈɡreɪt aɪˈdiːəz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know! She's funny and outgoing. She's the girl who talks to everyone at parties.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! ʃiːz ˈfʌni ənd ˌaʊtˈɡoʊɪŋ. ʃiːz ðə ˈɡɜːrl huː ˈtɔːks tə ˈɛvriwʌn ət ˈpɑːrtiz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And she's very kind. She always helps people who need help.
dialogue.reading: ənd ʃiːz ˈvɛri ˈkaɪnd. ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhɛlps ˈpiːpəl huː ˈniːd ˈhɛlp.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, she is. What are you like at parties, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ʃiː ˈɪz. ˈwʌt ər juː ˈlaɪk ət ˈpɑːrtiz, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm not very outgoing. I'm shy with people who I don't know.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˌaʊtˈɡoʊɪŋ. aɪm ˈʃaɪ wɪð ˈpiːpəl huː aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? You aren't shy with me!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? juː ˈɑːrənt ˈʃaɪ wɪð miː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's because you're a person who makes everyone feel happy!
dialogue.reading: ðæts bɪˈkɔːz jʊr ə ˈpɜːrsən huː ˈmeɪks ˈɛvriwʌn ˈfiːl ˈhæpi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! I like people who are funny, so I'm happy Ploy is coming.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈpiːpəl huː ər ˈfʌni, soʊ aɪm ˈhæpi ˈplɔɪ ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! It's going to be a great party.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə bi ə ˈɡreɪt ˈpɑːrti.
